name: Taunting Strike (Combat)
body:
You provoke your enemy so they focus their attacks on you.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Intimidate 10 Ranks

Benefit: When using Power Attack, you may taunt the target of your successful Power Attack. For 1d4 rounds the target focuses on you gaining a +2 insight bonus to attack you, but the target suffers a -4 penalty when attacking any other creature or object. Special: This is a mind-effect.
